title: Portfolio Cost-Resilience and Incremental-Lot Allocation Envelope

macro_program.name: portfolio_capital_risk
macro_program.unit_role: One small verifiable unit inside the macro research program, not a successor program or an execution-safety task.

question: Across the frozen six-strategy shared portfolio, does any strategy retain broad positive economics under one fixed 2x/3x/4x transaction-cost envelope strongly enough to justify exactly one later entry-preserving incremental-lot allocation Proxy?
economic_hypothesis: A strategy whose edge remains positive across periods as the observed cost unit is increased may deserve only future deposit-funded volume above the unchanged base minimum lot; cost fragility is diagnostic and never authorizes suppression of a frozen opportunity.
why_now: Recent units concentrated on Program 1 fresh market-response states and Program 7 single causal fields. The immediately considered same-symbol overlap question was not opened because it was adjacent to recently closed portfolio slot/interactions work. This unit rotates to Program 5 and treats all three fixed cost books only as economic stress inputs for a future incremental-lot allocation decision.

bundle_rotation.exception: Only a passing fixed gate may retain the one explicitly bounded incremental-lot Proxy; every other nearby cost multiple, fee decomposition or cost-conditioned variation remains closed.

immutable_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_declaration_feasibility.inspection_scope: Input existence, hashes, event schema and already-authoritative lifecycle densities only. No new strategy-period cost book, cost headroom, profit factor, drawdown, retention ratio or allocation verdict was calculated.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a persisted-state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each fresh period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence and source path plus source line. CLOSE and EXTERNAL_CLOSE precede a birth at equal time.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_birth: PASSIVE_PLACE stores positive planned risk; only its matched PASSIVE_FILL begins Passive occupancy.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle. value_a is native actual net USD and value_b is the frozen 2x-cost stressed net USD.
fixed_reconstruction.observed_cost_unit: For each lifecycle, actual_net minus stressed_2x_net. It must be finite and nonnegative.

cost_books.2x: actual_net - 1 * observed_cost_unit; this must reproduce value_b exactly.

fixed_reconstruction.linear_stress_limit: The 3x and 4x books are fixed arithmetic economic stresses for Program 5 lot-allocation information. They are not claims that spread, commission, swap and slippage scale identically in a future broker environment and do not open Program 6 execution, recovery or broker-safety research.
fixed_reconstruction.profit_factor: Sum positive lifecycle net divided by absolute sum negative lifecycle net; positive infinity is recorded only if gross loss is exactly zero.
fixed_reconstruction.closed_drawdown: Within each strategy-period and pooled strategy sequence, start cumulative net at zero, maintain a nonnegative running peak and take the largest peak-minus-current cumulative-net drawdown.
fixed_reconstruction.period_contribution: Largest positive 4x period net divided by the sum of positive 4x period nets.
fixed_reconstruction.retention_ratio: Pooled 4x net divided by pooled 2x net; a nonpositive pooled 2x denominator fails the strategy before this ratio is used.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six files retain the listed byte lengths and SHA-256 values and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 closed lifecycles with strategy totals RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594.
Reconstruct exact period 2x stressed nets 148.8735, 54.6630, 113.0380 and 90.4732 USD and pooled 407.0477 USD.
Reconstruct exact pooled actual net 444.19 USD.

Every lifecycle has one finite actual net, one finite 2x stressed net, a finite nonnegative observed cost unit and exactly one close; no same-strategy overlap, planned-risk or Passive pending fault is allowed.
Every strategy has at least 20 lifecycles in every period.

requirements: The strategy's 3x-cost net is strictly positive in all four periods.
The strategy's 4x-cost net is strictly positive in at least three of four periods and pooled 4x net is strictly positive.
Pooled 4x profit factor is at least 1.10.
Pooled 4x net retains at least 40% of pooled 2x net.
No single positive period contributes more than 60% of the strategy's summed positive 4x period net.
fixed_economic_gate.selection: If more than one strategy passes, select exactly one by higher pooled 4x net-to-drawdown, then higher 4x-to-2x retention, then higher pooled 4x net, then more positive 4x periods, then lexicographic strategy name.
fixed_economic_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later independently identified whole-six-strategy shared-portfolio Proxy that applies the selected strategy only to deposit-funded volume above the unchanged base minimum lot. It must preserve every frozen opportunity, never reduce any strategy below its base minimum lot, preserve the exact 4%/12% gates, compare against deposit-matched linear sizing, and cannot authorize Live.
fixed_economic_gate.failure_action: Close the bundle with no cost-resilience allocation Proxy. Do not rescue with 2.5x/3.5x/5x, spread-versus-commission decomposition, financing removal, direction, session, symbol, period omission, strategy subset or adjusted gate.
fixed_economic_gate.cost_fragility_action: A fragile strategy is recorded descriptively only and is never suppressed, removed, delayed or reduced below base minimum lot by this unit.

verdict_rules.success: PASS_ONE_COST_RESILIENT_INCREMENTAL_LOT_PROXY_QUESTION when integrity passes and at least one strategy passes every economic gate; select exactly one by the frozen ordering.
verdict_rules.failure: NO_COST_RESILIENCE_ALLOCATION_FIELD_PASSED when integrity passes and no strategy passes every economic gate.
verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_INPUT_OR_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_ECONOMIC_VERDICT when any input, lifecycle, cost-unit or anchor reconstruction gate fails.
verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_NO_CANDIDATE only if integrity passes but an unforeseen semantic condition outside the frozen arithmetic prevents a unique interpretation without changing the contract; do not reinterpret or add a rescue path.

required_evidence.proxy: one fixed hash-anchored in-memory 2x/3x/4x lifecycle aggregation
required_evidence.real_tick: no new run; inputs are the immutable already-consumed valid real-tick portfolio event matrix
required_evidence.result: family-local result JSON with integrity, portfolio books, strategy-period books, gate application and selection
required_evidence.closure: family-local closure JSON plus minimal Frontier and project state update

termination: Apply exactly one of success, failure, invalid or ambiguous under the frozen rules.
Freeze the family without a nearby cost-envelope successor.
Update the single Frontier ledger and required project state minimally.
Review only this unit's repository changes, commit to main and push origin/main.

Recompare active macro Programs 1-5 and 7, with special attention to underrepresented Programs 2, 3 and 4, then rotate the next unit away from Program 5 unless this unit passes and retains its sole explicitly bounded Proxy question.
stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before calculating any Unit 039 strategy-period 3x/4x net, profit factor, drawdown, retention ratio or verdict.
Run exactly one successful fixed aggregation; an implementation-only failure before any metric or verdict may be corrected once and disclosed.
Do not retain a reusable analysis CLI, run MT5, add MQL or modify another family.
Do not open the unselected same-symbol overlap question or any adjacent cost rescue inside this unit.
Do not open Program 6 execution, recovery or broker-safety work inside this Goal; report an encountered safety boundary without converting it into a research unit.
Do not query, restart or alter Live.
